plainTranslation: Their Pluto in your 7th house activates partnership as a place of transformation and power. You may feel drawn in quickly, and the bond can expose control patterns on both sides. Powerful is not automatically safe; watch how conflict is handled.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
